components.name: Star canopy/wall wedge
components.function: Need star-plan wall/canopy wedges, shell capital/column seats, radial stair and dry-path/reef joins. Reuse source gold finials/tidal-rock vocabulary. Seagrass/seaweed are flora; actual living coral/polyps, fish and crustaceans are fauna, separate from coral-shaped stone carving. Tidal support unverified. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated star canopy/wall wedge matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
